id.transformation: Copy the exact ConfigDataHeroInfo ID into the Hero Identity owner.
id.scope: Playable Hero identity only; not Full Detail population or publication eligibility.
id.limitation: Does not establish any other required Full Detail field.

nameEng.scope: The current required Full Detail field for Hero 15.
nameEng.limitation: Hero 15 is absent from the Full Detail Canonical; the admitted Hero Identity record contains only heroId and provenance. No approved nameEng claim is established by this readiness record.

portrait.transformation: Preserve the explicit HeroInfo.CharImage_ID to CharImageInfo.ID reference and byte-preserving extracted asset as internal evidence only.
portrait.limitation: Evidence declares canonical=false, generated=false, and publicationApproved=false. It does not admit the required Canonical Full Detail portrait field or authorize public exposure.

jobConnections.transformation: Reuse explicit Hero-to-Job relation claims and the separately validated internal Job Tree connection references; do not derive advancement edges or display names.
jobConnections.scope: Six admitted Hero-to-Job membership relations; record projection only.
jobConnections.limitation: The relation Canonical stores heroId/jobId, while the Full Detail record additionally requires connectionId and sourceField. No new admission or owner mapping is asserted here. Inherited source record bytes were not directly retrieved in the prior relation validation.

provenance.scope: Claim-level provenance required by the Full Detail Canonical record.
provenance.limitation: Existing identity, Portrait, and Job membership claims have traceable provenance, but the record cannot be assembled without resolving nameEng and the Canonical field projection gates.

limitations: This artifact records readiness checks only; it does not admit Canonical claims, approve publication, or change population.
The existing 29 Full Detail records and their generated counterparts remain unchanged.
Portrait publication approval is independent from Population Migration; Canonical Portrait field admission remains a separate Owner gate.
Hero 15 Full Detail Field Publication, Public Eligibility, Frontend reachability, and Hosted QA are not approved or verified by this artifact.
